# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.5 Worker 2: The Indian Ocean and the Subcontinent (oe_ind_, Slot 91, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v115_india.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Fallback for Slot 91 when the scheduler's host (BYZ) is gone: same chain as the other late slots.
# Deduplicated per calendar month via global_var:oe_ind_ran_m.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_ind_fallback_pulse
		oe_ind_country_quarterly
	}
}

oe_ind_fallback_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { global_var:oe_ind_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		OR = {
			current_month = 1
			current_month = 4
			current_month = 7
			current_month = 10
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind_init }
		}
		OR = {
			AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } tag = VEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } tag = GEN }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } tag = CHI }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } tag = MNG }
			AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:VEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:GEN } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } NOT = { country_exists = c:MNG } tag = TUR }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
			oe_ind_monthly = yes
		}
	}
}

# The theatre's protagonists, once a quarter (the month test comes first, so other months cost one comparison).
oe_ind_country_quarterly = {
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			current_month = 3
			current_month = 6
			current_month = 9
			current_month = 12
		}
		oe_ind_is_protagonist = yes
		oe_ind_country_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		oe_ind_country_tick = yes
	}
}
